verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a public sandbox or test environment for a machine filing channel, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, which say nothing about any documented sandbox, test environment, or machine channel. No crawling beyond robots.txt was performed, so there is no evidence the capability exists.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
